title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24
source: AKG 414 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLII-S/TDK MA-R)

ai_review.summary: A solid audience recording that captures the hall’s ambience and a standout 9‑minute Supplication, but the overall show is viewed as merely decent.
ai_review.review: The tape faithfully reproduces the U‑Hall crowd mood and acoustics, delivering very good sound despite some venue boom that makes a pure board mix preferable. Reviewers praise the extended Supplication and an adventurous Birdsong, yet one notes the concert itself wasn’t among the band’s great nights. Overall it’s a worthwhile document for Deadheads who value atmosphere over pristine performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is rated good by both reviewers, while the musical performance receives mixed feedback (one highly positive, one lukewarm), resulting in a mid‑range rating with limited review count.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captures crowd mood and hall acoustics well; some boom from the venue makes it less clean than a soundboard source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set mixes up material and ranks among the better ’82 sets according to one reviewer, though overall the show is deemed not great.
